supersedes_note: The jsgui3-server examples/docs-viewer shell remains a bounded minimal contract reference, but its implementation is currently parked in local stashes and absent from the owner checkout/history. The extensive, user-facing viewer is owned by jsgui3-own-website and uses real jsgui3 controls with SSR and client activation.

rendering_model.ssr: Controls compose their tree in the constructor when spec.el is absent, so the server produces the page HTML.
rendering_model.activation: On the client the framework reattaches each control to its existing DOM element and calls activate() to bind events. This is activation, not hydration; the client does not re-render or diff a virtual tree. activate() is guarded by if (this.__active) return.
rendering_model.isomorphic_entry: A single client.js defines and registers the controls and is passed to jsgui3-server as src_path_client_js, so the same control code renders on the server and activates on the client.
rendering_model.source_reads_on_server: All filesystem reads happen on the server in route/API handlers; the client bundle never reads files.

owner_readiness.gate: Preserve pre-existing and unrelated edits. Phase 9 unifies public example naming, adds bounded metadata-only search match context, respects reduced-motion preferences, and makes atlas keyboard focus visible. It must pass the owner HTTP/browser suite, ecosystem contract checks, a private Oracle candidate gate, and the complete public route/browser/security gate before PM2 state is saved.
